Method of Attack: Uses Wake-on-Lan feature to power on devices on a compromised network
Scans device's ARP table for private IP subnets
Sends Wake-on-Lan magic packets to devices' MAC addresses to power them on
Attempts to mount remote device's C$ administrative share
Encrypts remote computer's drive after mounting share
Impacted Systems: Devices on compromised corporate networks with private IP subnets 10., 172.16., 192.168.
Attack Vector: Wake-on-Lan packets sent to devices on local network
Subprocess spawned with '8 LAN' argument to trigger scanning and WoL packets
Indicators of Compromise: Wake-on-Lan magic packet containing 'FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF'
Mounting of remote C$ administrative share
